patches.scope: Opt-in direct raster sampling on native terrain; native camera, DEM, overlays and normal rendering fallback.
Runtime colour-texture filtering controls; deferred mip generation and anisotropy policy.
Shared texture anisotropy cache, including native parent imagery and recycled terrain targets.
Native terrain index variants share native vertices and skirts; DEM border revisions invalidate runtime error metadata.
Index native fallback-child candidates; retain native isChildOf, loaded order, requested detail and coverage checks.
Indexed image admission, adaptive ready reserve, optional tracing and bounded moving RTT refresh; no shaders or terrain data changes.
Reuse native integrals only when FOV, vertical distance and range match exactly; preserve native arithmetic, per-tile distance, selection and detail.
Reuse at most 128 exact native tile-local projection matrices, preserving native arithmetic, fresh output ownership, camera transforms and custom tile-range projection.
Use the pinned native calculateScaledKey for DEM ancestry lookups; preserve exact lookup keys/order, cache reads, min/max zoom and fallback behavior.
